paper_metadata.title: Aluminum-tuned the strength-ductility synergy in Ti50Zr30Nb20-xAlx refractory medium-entropy alloys

evidence.quote: a series of Ti50Zr30Nb20-xAlx alloys with single-phase BCC structure and ambient ductility were designed and synthesized
the plasticity of the alloys decreases as Al content increases. This conclusion is consistent with previous studies on Al-containing RMPEAs
This study systematically investigates the effects of substituting aluminum (Al) for niobium (Nb) on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ti50Zr30Nb20-xAlx (x = 0 to 10 at.%) RMEAs.
